description: This file declares the 'Request' class within the WebSockets::JsonRpc namespace, which is a derived class from WPEFramework::Core::JSONRPC::Message for handling JSON RPC request messages over WebSockets. It includes method declarations for creating requests, retrieving IDs, and converting to string, as well as a private ID generator and a static atomic sequence counter.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Represents a JSON RPC request message used over WebSockets, capable of creating requests, generating unique IDs, and serializing to string.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Initializes the request with a method name and parameters.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Retrieves the unique ID associated with this request.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Serializes the request into a JSON string representation.

methods.name: generateId
methods.description: Generates a unique ID for the request, using an atomic counter.
